description:
Cast Lightwheel Enhancements either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying {W}, attaching it to Rograkh.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Rograkh, adding {W}.
When Rograkh dies, Koll triggers, returning Rograkh from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Rograkh by paying {0}.
Repeat.
